jobs.occupation: SAP Financial Compliance & Authorizations Deployment Specialist (m/f/d) - 2 years fixed term (Betriebswirt/in (Fachschule) - international)
jobs.description: At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections,  where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.The PositionASPIRE is a multi-year program that will define, design, and deploy Future ERP solutions based on SAP S/4 HANA and other cloud/on-premise technology platforms. The program will enable simplified, standardized, and harmonized global business processes by capitalizing on SAP, Life Science Industry and Roche effective practices.The opportunity: * Preparation and leading of FIT-to-Template (assessment of the current business processes compared and aligned against the future Aspire Global Template) and scoping workshops for Financial Compliance* Liaising with local affiliate Finance stakeholders for the implementation of Financial Compliance requirements* Assessment of localization requirements for Authorization* Execution of Testing Activities during the deployment (UT, SAT, UAT, REG)* Go Live & Hyper care (incl. Month end closing) support* Ensure template governance within the project including change control management in line with the respective GBPMs/GBPOs and the overall Finance governance conceptWho you are* You have a university degree in Business Administration, Accounting or a related field.* 5+ years related business experience or equivalent Project Management skills in the area of SAP Authorization* Broad knowledge of business processes, policies and programs* Strong Project Management, business partner management, communication and change management skills. Experience in Agile Project Methodologies is a plus* Strong people skills are required as the role is highly consultative, interacting with staff at all levels across an organization * Proficiency in EnglishIn exchange we provide you with:* Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. Role overviewAltera is seeking an experienced Field Sales Engineer to drive growth across an assigned territory in the Central EMEA region. Depending on the candidate’s background and the business need, the role may focus primarily on either:- Growing territory coverage, distribution customers, and channel-partner design wins; or- Developing a defined set of strategic customers through focused demand creation and account initiatives.The successful candidate will combine technical credibility, commercial drive, and strong relationship-building skills to turn customer and market opportunities into sustainable revenue growth.Job responsibilities- Develop and execute sales plans to achieve or exceed assigned revenue and design win targets.- Identify, qualify, and pursue new business opportunities, including early-stage demand creation and design-win activity.- Manage and grow customer accounts and, where applicable, distribution partners through strong multi-level relationships.- Own the broader commercial relationship with strategic customers and channel partners, including pricing, contractual terms, volume commitments, supply expectations, and issue escalation.- Understand customer needs and position Altera’s products and solutions effectively.- Prepare and deliver sales presentations, product demonstrations, technical proposals, and business cases.- Drive opportunities through the sales cycle, from prospecting and technical engagement through design win, negotiation, and closure.- Build joint business plans with channel partners or account plans with strategic customers, depending on the assigned focus.- Collaborate closely with field application engineering, applications engineering, marketing, product management, and product development.- Maintain accurate forecasts, pipeline data, opportunity plans, and customer information in the CRM system.- Monitor industry trends, competitive activity, and market conditions to identify opportunities and risks.- Represent Altera at customer meetings, industry events, trade shows, and partner activities.- Travel regularly within the assigned territory in Central EMEA.Qualifications- Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.- At least five years of successful experience targets.- Strong understanding of FPGAs, SoCs, and related hardware and software design flows is highly preferred.- Experience with distribution partners, channel ecosystems, strategic accounts, or technology-driven customer programs.- Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.- Strong customer-development, opportunity-management, forecasting, and CRM skills.- jobs.occupation: RDT Business Partner (m/w/d) RDT Pharma International (Informationsmanager/in)
jobs.description: At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections,  where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.The PositionLet’s build a healthier future, together. In the role of RDT Business Partner at Roche Digital Technology (RDT) / Informatics, you will make a decisive contribution to turning our vision "Doing now what patients need next" into reality. You are part of RDT Pharma International and belong to the RDT Business Partner team at the preferred location in Grenzach. Here, we combine technological innovation with commercial goals to continuously improve patient care through digital solutions and actively shape the healthcare ecosystem.Responsibilities | What awaits youIn this role, you will take responsibility for the strategic connection between Roche Digital Technology (RDT) and the assigned business functions to advance Roche's strategic goals through groundbreaking technology solutions. In addition, you will take on the following exciting tasks:* Stakeholder Management: You act as a trusted strategic partner and advisor to business leaders, co-create technology-enabled strategies, and proactively drive global process improvements.* Bridge between Local & Global: You bundle the local requirements of the business functions (Commercial, Finance, P&C, Supply Chain, etc.), advocate for local needs at the global level when necessary, and conversely bring global standard solutions effectively to Germany.* Innovation & Impact: You specifically identify business opportunities and work closely with Product Leads to design, prototype, and continuously develop innovative technological capabilities.* Complexity Management: You are accountable for the successful delivery of technology-enabled business outcomes (such as annual revenue goals or patient access) for commercial areas.* Problem Solving: In strong partnership with Product Engineering Teams, you are responsible for the escalation and targeted resolution of complex, systemic challenges.* Technology Focus: As a Key Opinion Leader, you drive the technological vision forward, manage stakeholders end-to-end, and scale pilot solutions to maximize their added value.Qualifications | Who you areFor this demanding interface role, you bring sound IT knowledge, strong business acumen, and excellent communication skills:* Education: Successfully completed Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field; a Master’s degree or MBA is a plus.* Professional Experience & Industry Knowledge: Sound experience participating in IT projects within complex matrix organizations as well as strong business acumen in the pharmaceutical / life sciences environment.* Partnership & Moderation: Proven track record of building trusted relationships across different organizational levels (including management level), as well as strong competence in conflict management and moderating complex interfaces.* Language & Communication Skills: You bring excellent communication skills (fluent/negotiating-level English for collaboration in a global environment as well as very good German skills for daily interaction at the Grenzach site).* Working Style & Presence: High flexibility, strong analytical skills, and systems thinking, as well as the willingness for on-site presence at the Grenzach location.* Teamwork: Strong ability to collaborate constructively in cross-functional, agile teams and to actively promote appreciative cooperation.Duration: This position is a temporary assignment limited until January 2028.Your ApplicationWe ask you for a current CV and your official (educational) certificates/proofs. Further documents are currently not mandatory. Please note before submitting the application that no further documents can be added afterwards. Apply now – we look forward to meeting you!  Your contact to us! With people. For people.Do you need further support?Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq.Who we areA healthier future drives us to innovate. Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:IT-ProjektmanagerStellenbeschreibung:We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced IT Project Manager to join our dynamic team, with a special focus on the Human Resources domain. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of successfully managing complex IT projects and a strong understanding of IT and HR processes and Systems.The position is placed in Rudersberg at WERU GmbH with projects both in Germany as well as Switzerland.You will work closely with a team consisting of IT management, Project Managers, specialists and project participants from both the business and IT. The goal is to optimize current processes and initiate new initiatives as part of the industrialization process and journey DOVISTA is on. You will work with data and digitalization projects involving upgrades and implementation of IT systems. An informal tone, humor, and mutual respect characterize everyday life.We place emphasis on your ability to work efficiently and independently. You take responsibility for your tasks and maintain an overview and work in a structured manner.About WERU:Quality that lasts. Doors and windows with a rich tradition.Windows and doors with a heritage you can feel—and technology that impresses. Since 1843, WERU has been among the pioneers of the window and door industry. With high-quality PVC and PVC-aluminum solutions, we create living spaces that impress with their design, energy efficiency, security, and durability. Our recognition as a “Brand of the Century” is both a confirmation and an incentive for us: tradition meets innovation.Rudersberg—the birthplace of our company—remains the heart of our business to this day. Drawing on over 180 years of expertise and the technology of tomorrow, our team of approximately 600 employees develops solutions that perfectly combine sustainability, quality, and living comfort.Your responsibilities:- Lead and manage end-to-end IT projects within the HR and IT area, ensuring delivery on time, within scope, and within budget- Collaborate with stakeholders to define project requirements and objectives- Develop comprehensive project plans, including timelines and resource allocation- Translate strategic initiatives into processes and projects that can be implemented in DOVISTA- Monitor project progress, identify risks, and implement mitigation strategies- Facilitate communication between IT technical teams, HR departments and other stakeholders- Conduct regular project status meetings and provide detailed reports to senior management- Foster a culture of continuous improvement by identifying opportunities with top management to supportYour qualification:- Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science or a related field- Minimum 6 years of experience in project management, with a focus on HR systems and processes- Strong understanding of payroll and time-management systems- Exceptional organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills- Proficiency in project management tools and methodologies (e.g. Prince2, Scrum)- Certification in Project Management (e.g. Prince2, Scrum) is highly desirable- Fluent in English and German- Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills- Ability to influence and engage stakeholders across all organizational levelsErgänzende Informationen:Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach VereinbarungAnforderungen an den Bewerber: Expertenkenntnisse: IT-Organisation, Software-Implementierung, Systemintegration, IT-KoordinationZwingend erforderlich: Projektmanagement

We avoid the unnecessary and focus on what really matters – from overcoming challenges to celebrating our shared successes.- Flexibility and freedom: Every position is possible with an 80% workload.- Rapid growth: With us, growth is a continuous journey. We also support you with EDU Points (1600 € or 2000 minutes) (https://www.galaxus.de/de/page/einmal-weiterbildung-bitte-20943)  per year for your professional development so there’s no risk of you getting stuck in a rut.- More benefits: 28 days of holiday, exclusive employee conditions in our online shop, a shuttle service and other benefits.Diversity is our culture.To build the best team, we want to draw from the full spectrum of talent out there. This means people from all walks of life have the same opportunities with us, regardless of their ethnicity, religion, disability status, gender identity, sexual orientation or age. We believe true inclusion means everyone is welcome and each contribution is valuable.Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Logistik, Transportlogistik

jobs.occupation: PhD position (m/f/d) on immune reset through CAR T in chronic inflammatory diseases (Biologe/Biologin)
jobs.description: State-of-the-art medicine and nursing care you can rely on! - Since being founded in 1815, Universitätsklinikum Erlangen has offered medicine of the highest standard and incorporated the latest insights from medical research and state-of-the-art equipment into diagnosis and therapy. More than 10.000 employees from approximately 50 different occupations are needed to provide the wide range of services offered by Universitätsklinikum Erlangen, ensuring our patients receive the very best care around the clock.As a PhD student, you will investigate how human immune-cell networks shape tissue inflammation, regeneration and response to cellular therapies. The project will focus primarily on the human immune system and combine patient-derived material with experimental models to address mechanistic questions in cellular immunology.Your tasks:- Characterizing human immune-cell populations and their functional states using multiparameter flow cytometry and high-dimensional immune phenotyping.- Investigating cellular interactions and immune networks by integrating phenotypic, functional and molecular data from immune cells and tissues.- Studying immune responses to cellular therapies, including the mechanisms underlying immune depletion, reconstitution and tissue regeneration following CD19 CAR-T-cell therapy.- Generating and analyzing molecular data using approaches such as bulk and single-cell RNA sequencing and other transcriptomic or spatial technologies.- Establishing and applying experimental models to investigate mechanisms identified in human samples, including selected mouse models of intestinal inflammation, immune reconstitution and tissue regeneration after CD19 CAR-T-cell therapy.- Developing and combining experimental and analytical approaches ranging from established methods such as ELISA, Western blotting and flow cytometry to advanced multidimensional cytometry, UMAP-based analysis and transcriptomic approaches.- The project offers substantial scope to develop an individual scientific profile. Previous experience with these techniques is welcome, but curiosity, scientific independence, willingness to learn, and enthusiasm for understanding how immune cells interact in human disease are similarly important.Essential experience/ qualifications:- Above the average motivation and work ethics- Strong theoretical and practical background in standard methods of molecular and cellular biology as well as cellular immunology- English writing and speaking skills- Ability to work together in a multi-national team that is supportive of one another- A master degree (M.Sc.) in immunology, biology, molecular biology, molecular medicine or equivalentadditional advantages:- Experience in omics data science- Hands-on experience in human immunologyWe offer:- The position is full-time and will be payed according to salary group TVL-E 13, 65% (DFG-typical rate)- Intended pay grade depending on qualifications and personal requierements- Initially, the position is limited for one year, with the possibility of an extension till the degreee is achieved- The head of the department guaranties in writing that there is funding till the degree is achieved.- Hiring process opened and will be completed asap.- An enthusiastic, interdisciplinary team of scientists and doctors- High end translational research- State-of-the-art laboratories- Two-Stepp mentoring with a hands-on mentor (post-doc) plus the PI as supervisor with high frequent project discussions for efficient development- Structured program for hard- and soft-skills in research (paper and grant writing classes, paper clubs, soft-skill training)- Notes for applicants (f/m/d) ( https://www.karriere.uk-erlangen.de/bewerbung/hinweise-fuer-bewerbende/ )- Comprehensive health promotion offers- All benefits of the public service incl. supplementary pension plan of the Versorgungsanstalt des Bundes und der Länder (VBL) (Federal and State Government Employees' Retierment Fund)- Family-friendly enviromentFurther information:Prof. Dr. med. habil. Fabian MüllerMedizinische Klinik 5Phone: 09131 - 85 43107Applications:Universitätsklinikum ErlangenMedizinische Klinik 5 -Hämatologie & Internistische OnkologiePD Dr. med. habil. Fabian MüllerUlmenweg 1891054 Erlangen

More than 10.000 employees from approximately 50 different occupations are needed to provide the wide range of services offered by Universitätsklinikum Erlangen, ensuring our patients receive the very best care around the clock.As a PhD student, you will investigate how human immune-cell networks shape tissue inflammation, regeneration and response to cellular therapies. The project will focus primarily on the human immune system and combine patient-derived material with experimental models to address mechanistic questions in cellular immunology.Your tasks:- Characterizing human immune-cell populations and their functional states using multiparameter flow cytometry and high-dimensional immune phenotyping.- Investigating cellular interactions and immune networks by integrating phenotypic, functional and molecular data from immune cells and tissues.- Studying immune responses to cellular therapies, including the mechanisms underlying immune depletion, reconstitution and tissue regeneration following CD19 CAR-T-cell therapy.- Generating and analyzing molecular data using approaches such as bulk and single-cell RNA sequencing and other transcriptomic or spatial technologies.- Establishing and applying experimental models to investigate mechanisms identified in human samples, including selected mouse models of intestinal inflammation, immune reconstitution and tissue regeneration after CD19 CAR-T-cell therapy.- Developing and combining experimental and analytical approaches ranging from established methods such as ELISA, Western blotting and flow cytometry to advanced multidimensional cytometry, UMAP-based analysis and transcriptomic approaches.- The project offers substantial scope to develop an individual scientific profile. Previous experience with these techniques is welcome, but curiosity, scientific independence, willingness to learn, and enthusiasm for understanding how immune cells interact in human disease are similarly important.Essential experience/ qualifications:- Above the average motivation and work ethics- Strong theoretical and practical background in standard methods of molecular and cellular biology as well as cellular immunology- English writing and speaking skills- Ability to work together in a multi-national team that is supportive of one another- A master degree (M.Sc.) in immunology, biology, molecular biology, molecular medicine or equivalentadditional advantages:- Experience in omics data science- Hands-on experience in human immunologyWe offer:- The position is full-time and will be payed according to salary group TVL-E 13, 65% (DFG-typical rate)- Intended pay grade depending on qualifications and personal requierements- Initially, the position is limited for one year, with the possibility of an extension till the degreee is achieved- The head of the department guaranties in writing that there is funding till the degree is achieved.- Hiring process opened and will be completed asap.- An enthusiastic, interdisciplinary team of scientists and doctors- High end translational research- State-of-the-art laboratories- Two-Stepp mentoring with a hands-on mentor (post-doc) plus the PI as supervisor with high frequent project discussions for efficient development- Structured program for hard- and soft-skills in research (paper and grant writing classes, paper clubs, soft-skill training)- Notes for applicants (f/m/d) ( https://www.karriere.uk-erlangen.de/bewerbung/hinweise-fuer-bewerbende/ )- Comprehensive health promotion offers- All benefits of the public service incl. supplementary pension plan of the Versorgungsanstalt des Bundes und der Länder (VBL) (Federal and State Government Employees' Retierment Fund)- Family-friendly enviromentFurther information:Prof. Dr. med. habil. Fabian MüllerMedizinische Klinik 5Phone: 09131 - 85 43107Applications:Universitätsklinikum ErlangenMedizinische Klinik 5 -Hämatologie & Internistische OnkologiePD Dr. med. habil. jobs.occupation: Head of Global Commodity Engineering Mechatronics 2 (f/m/d) (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule))
jobs.description: Job Posting: Head of Global Commodity Engineering Mechatronics 2 (m/f/d)Transform the everyday.This role is responsible for leading the global strategy, governance, and execution of Material Lifecycle Management for mechanical and mechatronic components across the entire supply chain. The individual ensures suppliers, manufacturing processes, quality standards, and material strategies are optimized for cost, quality, productivity, resilience, and sustainability while driving cross-functional collaboration between Procurement, Engineering, Manufacturing, Logistics, and Quality teams worldwide.In short, this is a senior global leadership position focused on improving supplier performance, product quality, operational efficiency, and supply chain effectiveness throughout the lifecycle of mechanical and mechatronic materials and components.What we offer you- Flexible training opportunities for both your professional and personal development that you can tailor to your interests- (Global) development programs that can be customized according to your wishes and ambitions- Diverse health and wellness offerings- A work environment where you can contribute with your whole personality and truly feel like part of SiemensSince each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here.The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.How you will make an Impact with us- You will be responsible for the global strategic direction of Material Lifecycle Management for mechanical and mechatronic components, including drawing-controlled parts, assemblies, manufacturing scopes, and supply chain investments.- You will lead a team  (either directly or through collaboration models) and provide functional governance for local Material Lifecycle Management teams focused on mechatronics. You will ensure clear roles, standards, decision-making processes, and effective cross-site collaboration.- You will develop and implement a global strategy for mechatronic parts, processes, and suppliers, focusing on standardization, technical feasibility, quality capability, supply chain resilience, sustainability, Total Cost of Ownership (TCO), and productivity.- You will define supplier quality-related processes, methods, and standards for mechanical components and drive their global deployment, application, and continuous optimization across an international network.- You will oversee preventive quality planning and industrialization readiness, particularly risk assessments, Process FMEA, Control Plans, Production Control Plans, First Article Inspection/PPAP, process audits, and release procedures for drawing-controlled purchased parts.- You will establish a robust supplier problem management system with clear 8D governance, root cause analysis, effectiveness verification, lessons learned, claims management, and escalation procedures to sustainably reduce quality costs and recurring defects.- You will further develop global and regional suppliers in collaboration with Procurement, R&D, Manufacturing, Logistics, and other partners, focusing on process capability, performance, technological expertise, capacity, risk mitigation, and ESG requirements.- You will drive transparency, digitalization, and data-based management through supplier quality KPIs, audit and action management, quality cost tracking, risk dashboards, and standardized management reporting.- You will identify productivity opportunities throughout the material lifecycle, including standardization, product variant reduction, make-or-buy optimization, value stream and supply chain analysis, cost and process improvements, and robust relocation and localization strategies.- You will represent Mechatronics Material Lifecycle Management in global decision-making committees and ensure strategic contributions are integrated early into development, sourcing, investment, and production decisions.What you bringLeadership & Governance- You bring extensive long-term leadership experience in global, multicultural organizations, including both direct people leadership and cross-functional management across sites, functions, and hierarchical levels. You are capable of developing teams, clarifying responsibilities, setting priorities, and driving organizational change effectively.Mechanical & Mechatronic Components- You possess a strong understanding of mechanical and mechatronic materials, especially drawing-controlled parts, manufacturing processes, tolerances, inspection concepts, process capability, industrialization, engineering changes, capital investments, and global supply chain risks.Strategy, Digitalization & Productivity- You have experience in strategy development, process standardization, digital reporting, data-driven decision-making, productivity programs, and leading complex transformation or optimization initiatives within international manufacturing and supplier networks.Methodological Expertise- Knowledge of quality and continuous improvement tools is advantageous, including:- Process FMEA- PPAP (Production Part Approval Process)- 8D Problem Solving- Ishikawa (Fishbone) Analysis- 5 Why Analysis- Pareto Analysis- Process Audits- Corrective Action Management- Lessons Learned Processes- Control Plans- KPI and Performance Reviews- Structured Escalation ProcessesCommunication & Collaboration- You are recognized for clear communication, diplomacy, negotiation skills, and the ability to align Procurement, R&D, Manufacturing, Quality, Finance, and Suppliers toward common goals. Fluency in both German and English, along with willingness to travel globally to company sites and suppliers, completes your profile.Languages: Fluent in English, additional languages are a plusYou are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce. At Siemens, we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values your skills and provides equitable opportunities to progress. For us, competitiveness goes hand in hand with diverse teams and a shared sense of belonging. Our technology is powered by innovation, fueled by the diverse thinking and the unique merits of our people. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday, for everyone, together with us.As an equal opportunity employer (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/company/about/social-commitments/belonging/) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities. In the case of equal qualifications, severely disabled applicants and applicants with equivalent status will be given preference.About usSiemens Digital Industries Automation (DI AUT) is one of the world’s leading providers of industrial automation. Our innovative automation portfolio enables companies of all sizes in both the process and discrete manufacturing industries to accelerate their automation—and thus their digital transformation—across the entire value chain. This allows our customers to increase productivity and flexibility and become future-ready through technologies such as software-defined systems and artificial intelligence. Siemens Xcelerator—the open digital business platform—helps to implement this more easily, quickly, and at scale. Together with partners and a broad ecosystem, Siemens supports its customers on their journey toward becoming a Digital Enterprise.otc2026diotc2026di
